new_lens_seeds.title: Dangerous Truth And Trust Collapse
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A truth, correction, or counter-narrative can become dangerous when institutional trust is so broken that every claim becomes another weapon, and the only remaining safeguard is careful conversation that preserves both evidence and the human target of speech.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism recurs across Jay's myth/truth challenge, Jiang's avian-flu case, the open-debate answer, and the broader Prediction problem of speculative truth outrunning facts.
new_lens_seeds.reason: This is a promising cross-page seed, but one interview should not create a public child. First compare against Hasan facts-versus-truth pressure, Prediction method self-audit, and Bureaucracy truth-reaction sources.
